# Wind Waker (G4)

Wind Waker is a background Pegasus stallion in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* and a member of the Wonderbolts, the aerial stunt team Rainbow Dash dreams of joining. Look for his nearly white, cream-colored coat, powder-blue mane and tail, purple eyes, and the team's blue-and-yellow flight suit. The [Wonderbolts roster](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Wonderbolts) identifies him by his design and appearances.

**Naming and voice:** “Wind Waker” is an unofficial fandom/wiki identification, not a verified spoken, credited, or merchandise name; the original naming proposal is unconfirmed. He is distinct from the similarly designed [Fire Streak](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Fire_Streak), whose name *is* spoken in the series. Wind Waker has no verified individual dialogue or credited voice actor.

**Appearances:** *Newbie Dash* (S6E7; first identified appearance), *Secrets and Pies* (S7E23), *The Washouts* (S8E20), and *The Ending of the End — Part 2* (S9E25). His appearances are chiefly as part of the Wonderbolts ensemble.

[![Attribution](https://derpicdn.net/img/2024/9/11/3440347/full.png)](https://derpibooru.org/images/3440347)

*Show still: Wonderbolts flying in “The Washouts”; production credited to Hasbro Studios/DHX Media. Image archive and tags are available at the linked post.*

## Important moments

1. **Rainbow's first team flight — “Newbie Dash” (S6E7).** Wind Waker appears in the Wonderbolts ensemble as Rainbow Dash finally joins the team and learns that belonging matters more than showing off. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q3nh6bSauu0) — scene timestamp unavailable.
2. **Showing the professional team — “The Washouts” (S8E20).** His team's disciplined formation flying provides a contrast to the Washouts' unsafe stunts, which endanger Scootaloo. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_jXb63DKSLw) — scene timestamp unavailable.
3. **Rallying against the villains — “The Ending of the End — Part 2” (S9E25).** The Wonderbolts join Equestria's united defenders against Chrysalis, Tirek, and Cozy Glow; Wind Waker is part of that ensemble, not singled out for an individual feat. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kb80vXxEoMo) — scene timestamp unavailable.
